certificate.criterion: valid hover with finite FULL augmented plant-sensor-estimator-controller Jacobian spectral radius strictly below one
certificate.lower_bound_condition: whenever a hover equilibrium and its full closed-loop Jacobian exist
certificate.unit_modes: shift only true world position; hold estimated state, reference, controller, actuator and sensor states fixed
certificate.equilibrium_absence: if no valid hover exists, the stated stable-hover event is also false
certificate.statement: For all PID gains, Q=integral 1{valid hover and full rho<1} d(mu_model)=0 under the stated IMU-only assumptions. This does not claim a computed value for rho or hover existence.

assumptions.external_residual_wrench: absent or position-independent time/command/IMU driven input
assumptions.measurement_noise: position independent; same realization preserves translation symmetry

certificate.known_initial_frame_caveat: An exactly known initial position/velocity can restrict a noise-free perfect-model run to an observer-error-zero manifold. Nominal tracking or stability on that restricted manifold is not ruled out. The three unobservable physical-position error modes remain in the FULL augmented internal-stability criterion; this is not a proof that every physical maneuver is impossible.
certificate.reduced_model_caveat: Removing gauge/error modes or analyzing an observable controlled subspace defines a different criterion and is not done here.

proof.observation_invariance: h_IMU(T_a x)=h_IMU(x); uniform-field magnetometer also invariant
proof.closed_loop_equivariance: Psi(T_a X)=T_a Psi(X) for any causal IMU-only estimator/controller
proof.consequence: rho(D(Psi)) >= 1; no claim about additional eigenvalues

criterion: strict asymptotic stability of ALL physical, sensor and estimator states
